phase_status.authority_note: docs/00_PROBLEM_STATEMENT.md overrides AUDIT_LOCAL_VS_DEFERRED.md overrides docs/PHASES.md. Re-read them at step 0; this block is a hint, not the source of truth.

queue.title: Resolve the governor latency-ceiling contradiction
queue.detail: Measured perception latency with the ViT active is 1782 ms p50 / 3023 ms p95 against a 500 ms p95 ceiling, so the governor demotes every page to T0 permanently. The 500 ms figure was derived from a 55 ms measurement taken while the ONNX model was silently never loading. Decide and implement one of: (a) re-derive the ceiling from an honest measurement and document the derivation, (b) move the ceiling off wall-clock perception latency onto something the tier actually controls, or (c) restructure T1 so it fits a defensible ceiling. Whichever is chosen, the reasoning goes in BENCHMARKS.md next to the number.
queue.verification_command: npm run benchmark:browser  (ViT active) + the governor tier-transition test
queue.notes: Blocks L2 — a PerceptionPolicy built on a ceiling that demotes everything is not testable.

queue.title: Implement PerceptionPolicy fast/thorough modes
queue.detail: Two named policies over the existing two-tier gating (T1 always-on single crop, T2 escalation on DOM-blind surfaces). Fast optimises the 15% latency bucket; thorough optimises the 25% visual-context bucket. The policy must be a declared, testable object — not scattered conditionals — and must not introduce any page-identity-dependent branching.
queue.verification_command: policy unit tests + benchmark:browser under each mode, both numbers recorded

queue.title: Build the held-out corpus with real photographic face fixtures
queue.detail: Face recall is currently 0 because the fixtures are drawn SVG faces that UltraFace cannot detect — the number is meaningless, not bad. Assemble a held-out corpus with genuine photographic faces (licence-clear), disjoint from the dev corpus, and never opened during tuning.
queue.verification_command: corpus build script + a run showing non-zero face detections on the new fixtures
queue.notes: This is the highest-value integrity item in the whole queue: it turns an unmeasured 20% rubric bucket into a measured one.

queue.title: Report the dev↔held-out generalisation gap
queue.detail: Run the full pipeline against dev and held-out corpora and publish both, with the gap stated explicitly. A large gap is a finding to report honestly, not a bug to tune away — tuning against held-out results destroys the point of the split.
queue.verification_command: eval harness run over both corpora, side-by-side table in BENCHMARKS.md

queue.title: Investigate the safe-control preservation regression
queue.detail: Safe-control preservation went from 100% (18/18) to 90.5% (19/21) in the same run that enabled the ViT. Two controls are now being lost. Identify which two and why before any further tuning — this touches the redaction-precision bucket (20%).
queue.verification_command: safe-control preservation test with the two failing controls named in the output
queue.notes: Denominator also changed 18→21; confirm whether the regression is real or a corpus-composition artefact before reporting it either way.

queue.title: Improve proposal quality for Bucket B (canvas/img controls)
queue.detail: Bucket B recall is 1/3. Raising the T2 crop budget 8x changed nothing, which localises the constraint to proposal quality rather than encode budget. Work on how candidate regions are proposed on DOM-blind surfaces.
queue.verification_command: Bucket B recall on the ablation harness, before and after
queue.notes: Directly targets the 25% visual-context bucket. Deprioritise below L3/L4 if time is short — a measured 1/3 is defensible, an unmeasured face recall is not.

queue.title: Assemble the freeze/submit checklist
queue.detail: Draft docs/FREEZE_CHECKLIST.md: reproducible build from a clean clone, demo script that does not depend on network, BENCHMARKS.md numbers all traceable to a command, retracted-claims register intact, no secrets in history, judge-facing README. Draft it early so gaps surface with time to fix them; tick it at the end.
queue.verification_command: clean-clone build + demo run from the checklist steps
queue.notes: Drafting is agent work. Ticking the final boxes and submitting is human work (H2).
